The CC-12b staging smoke (2026-11-03, worker at 203b12a, Fly release v5): the one access batch whose output the smoke saved, two pages of info.cern.ch, requested from the Fly egress. Rows as the deployed worker returned them; only the row and check ids were replaced, and nothing else was edited. The batch reported no partial reason and no finding; robots.txt answered 404, which the worker reads as no rules. `pages` holds the same two URLs from the smoke's saved crawl batch of info.cern.ch: their template key from the access batch, and robots.txt's verdict for each search engine as the crawl row recorded it.
